entries.38be0a4c0621d597: This business mainly supplies set manufacturers, using proprietary materials technology and other capabilities. It handles switching power supplies, toner and various modules. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥11,345 million. FUCHI ELECTRONICS CO., LTD. manufactures and sells electronic products, and FDK Partners Co., Ltd. handles outsourced processing of electronic products and similar work.
entries.765f4d8240dcb1ea: The Group consists of the company, 10 subsidiaries and 1 other related company. Its main business is the manufacture and sale of dry cells, rechargeable batteries, electronics-related materials and components, and their applied products; as reportable segments by product, it operates the Battery Business and the Electronics Business. The other related company is SILITECH TECHNOLOGY CORPORATION of Taiwan, which holds 45.07% of the company's voting rights and purchases the company's products.
entries.77a5e8462d2614fc: A manufacturer that makes and sells batteries such as alkaline dry batteries and nickel-metal hydride batteries, and electronic components such as switching power supplies and various modules.
entries.921ac2a3e04f6690: This business mainly sells consumer goods using energy storage-related devices. It handles alkaline batteries, nickel-metal hydride batteries, lithium batteries, manganese batteries, energy storage systems, various high-powered lights and battery manufacturing equipment. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥48,215 million. FDK Engineering Co., Ltd. manufactures battery manufacturing equipment and related items, BAOTOU FDK CO., LTD. manufactures and sells battery materials and rare-earth alloys, and XIAMEN FDK CORPORATION manufactures and sells battery products.
